notes: Dog Man is by Dav Pilkey (author field corrected from Unknown). The series features a comic-book-within-a-book format created by child characters Harold and George from Captain Underpants. Key themes are bravery, good vs evil, humour, and friendship. 'Bad guy' is a highly useful fringe word as the concept of villain is central to every book in the series. Consider sourcing Petey the Cat (villain) as a secondary character image if a second board is ever made for this series. The word 'funny' is important as humour and silliness are core to the book's appeal and student engagement.
